name: Soft Gecko 85
author: adamgiebl
description: Glass gradient rounded amber button that scales up on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, background changes from linear-gradient(#ffffff, #969696) to #0061ff, background changes from linear-gradient(#ffffff, #969696) to #ff1b6b, background changes from linear-gradient(#ffffff, #969696) to #bf0fff.
